### Complete changelog

  * [#54792](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/54792) - Enforce the `@AuthenticationContext` step-up policy for `@TestSecurity` tests
  * [#57046](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/57046) - Occasional CI failure: KafkaConnectorTest
  * [#57478](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/57478) - Allow extensions to contribute persistence unit managed classes by package
  * [#57574](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/57574) - quarkus 3.40.1: dev UI not working
  * [#58136](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58136) - OpenTelemetry resource customization drops service entity when telemetry service name differs from application name
  * [#58138](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58138) - Preserve OpenTelemetry service entity with explicit service name
  * [#58323](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58323) - Cache observer resolution in ArC
  * [#58349](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58349) - Config mapping error in extension subproject
  * [#58376](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58376) - Do not load local Gradle extensions as application archives in IDE launches
  * [#58380](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58380) - CacheControlDelegate mis-parses quoted field lists in Cache-Control
  * [#58381](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58381) - Parse quoted field lists in Cache-Control headers correctly
  * [#58415](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58415) - Qute: {#if a && b || c} is false when a is false and c is true
  * [#58416](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58416) - Continue a Qute #if condition after an && short-circuit
  * [#58436](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58436) - Take the inputs of the Gradle quarkusBuild task from the tasks that build the application parts
  * [#58476](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58476) - Make the Gradle tasks consuming the application model reusable from a build cache in another checkout
  * [#58503](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58503) - Fix dead fragment links by replacing relative links with absolute ones
  * [#58506](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58506) - Kafka Streams Dev UI: the object URL created for the topology download is never released
  * [#58507](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58507) - Release the object URL after downloading the Kafka Streams topology
  * [#58526](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58526) - Fix a test and make images consistent in tests
  * [#58527](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58527) - Make large DTO in test larger as ASM is now more efficient
  * [#58528](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58528) - Redis pub/sub: subscribe() from an event loop never completes, its SUBSCRIBE confirmation is dropped and the connection stays subscribed (3.40)
  * [#58529](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58529) - Agroal Dev UI: object URLs created for binary cell download links are never released
  * [#58530](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58530) - Fix flaky KafkaConnectorTest
  * [#58531](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58531) - Create the Agroal binary download URL on click and revoke it
  * [#58541](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58541) - Rename quarkus-test-spring to quarkus-spring-test
  * [#58545](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58545) - Spring Test - Rename module from test-spring to spring-test
  * [#58546](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/58546) - Native executable answers HTTP/1.0 requests with 501 Not Implemented in 4.0.0.CR1 (JVM and 3.x native return 200)
  * [#58550](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58550) - OIDC: Fix back-channel logout requests hanging on unexpected errors
  * [#58553](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58553) - Fix HTTP/1.0 returning 501 in native mode
  * [#58556](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/58556) - Install the Redis pub/sub reply hand

# Quarkus - Supersonic Subatomic Java

Quarkus is a Cloud Native, (Linux) Container First framework for writing Java applications.

* **Container First**:
Minimal footprint Java applications optimal for running in containers.
* **Cloud Native**:
Embraces [12 factor architecture](https://12factor.net) in environments like Kubernetes.
* **Versatile**:
From the smallest microservice to the largest monolith.
* **Fast startup**:
We do more at build time, we start fast.
* **JVM and native**
JVM for high throughput, native for constrained environments.
* **Unify imperative and reactive**:
Brings under one programming model non-blocking and imperative styles of development.
* **Standards-based**:
Based on the standards and frameworks you love and use (RESTEasy and JAX-RS, Hibernate ORM and JPA, Netty, Eclipse Vert.x, Eclipse MicroProfile, Apache Camel...).
* **Developer Joy**:
Development centric experience without compromise to bring your amazing apps to life in no time.

_All under ONE framework._

## Getting Started

* [Documentation](https://quarkus.io)
* [Wiki](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/wiki)

## Migration Guides

We collect all the migration notes in our [migration guides](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/wiki/Migration-Guides).

## Release Planning

Interested in when the next release is coming? Check our [release planning](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/wiki/Release-Planning) document for details.

## How to build Quarkus

The build instructions are available in the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md).
